Version 1.3.5
Author: Marcin Stankiewicz
License: GNU GPLv3 (Open Source)

Ultra-lightweight no-root application firewall and telemetry filter. Granularly controls internet access, protects your privacy and blocks background trackers with zero battery drain.
Control background data collection and telemetry networks. If an app requires a specific service to function properly, you can unblock that network anytime.
Enter a server domain to block (e.g. telemetry.example.com):
In-app analytics and third-party media SDK endpoints
Commercial profiling and user analytics network
Mobile telemetry and device profiling platform
Third-party media delivery and telemetry servers
Programmatic tracking and telemetry SDK servers
Global mobile analytics and tracking network
Cross-app promotion and user profiling platform
Designed for active apps! Core app traffic flows directly with zero lag, while telemetry, tracking, and third-party profiling domains are filtered out.
Need to unblock a specific analytics or media provider? Tap the filter icon at the top and toggle the network. You have full granular control over your device.
Inspect real-time network requests from this app. If unexpected connections appear in the background, find and block their domain here with 1 click.
Tip: Use the app while sniffing is active, then switch back here. The newest contacted domains appear right at the top!
Protection is OFF. Traffic capture and domain filtering require the master switch to be turned ON.
A floating button over your apps allows you to temporarily unblock connections with 1 tap, then automatically resumes protection when the countdown timer expires.
Automatically re-enables protection after the countdown finishes.
